origin.description: Prints the value labels of a labelled vector.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: An optional name printed on the heading.

origin.details: An empty label set prints nothing. A vector that is not labelled is an error.
origin.value: The input, invisibly. The labels are printed.

translation.description: Prints the value labels of a labelled vector.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: An optional name printed on the heading.

translation.details: An empty label set prints nothing. A vector that is not labelled is an error.
translation.value: The input, invisibly. The labels are printed.
translation.example:
from haven import labelled, print_labels
s1 = labelled(["M", "M", "F"], {"Male": "M", "Female": "F"})
print_labels(s1, "s1")
